may31HoldoutBenchmark.dominantCategories: Weather-carry chaos 5, Crooked-inning game 4, Early-pressure side 2
may31HoldoutBenchmark.stressSlateUse: This is the primary May 31 stress-slate benchmark. Future M2 variants should score this date without using May 31 outcomes in training or rule selection.

benchmarkRules: Do not overwrite this file when experimenting. Add a new benchmark artifact for any new model or rule version.
Future M2 variants may train on data through 2026-05-30, but May 31 must be treated as holdout.
A candidate should beat the overall M2 category lane hit rate or the May 31 holdout lane hit rate without worsening the main failure categories.
Moneyline-only improvement is not enough. M2 must improve market expression: side, F5, O/U, total, first inning, live-only, or no-pregame-ML.
The May 31 O/U holdout target is 5/5. Any M2 successor that claims better game-shape modeling must preserve or beat that O/U benchmark.
Any use of May 31 outcomes during rule design must be called retrospective and cannot count as a clean holdout win.
